pli-tv-pvr1.8:1.1: methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevanto kati āpattiyo āpajjati :
pli-tv-pvr1.8:1.2: methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevanto tisso āpattiyo āpajjati :
pli-tv-pvr1.8:1.3: akkhayite sarīre methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevati, āpatti pārājikassa;
pli-tv-pvr1.8:1.4: yebhuyyena khayite sarīre methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevati, āpatti thullaccayassa.
pli-tv-pvr1.8:1.5: vattakate mukhe acchupantaṃ aṅgajātaṃ paveseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa –
pli-tv-pvr1.8:1.6: methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevanto imā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati :
pli-tv-pvr1.8:2.1: tā āpattiyo catunnaṃ vipattīnaṃ kati vipattiyo bhajanti : sattannaṃ āpattikkhandhānaṃ katīhi āpattikkhandhehi saṅgahitā : channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ katīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhanti : catunnaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ katamaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ : sattannaṃ samathānaṃ katīhi samathehi sammanti :
pli-tv-pvr1.8:2.2: tā āpattiyo catunnaṃ vipattīnaṃ dve vipattiyo bhajanti :
pli-tv-pvr1.8:2.5: siyā pārājikāpattikkhandhena, siyā thullaccayāpattikkhandhena, siyā dukkaṭāpattikkhandhena.
pli-tv-pvr1.8:2.7: kāyato ca cittato ca samuṭṭhanti, na vācato
pli-tv-pvr1.8:2.10: siyā sammukhāvinayena ca paṭiññātakaraṇena ca, siyā sammukhāvinayena ca tiṇavatthārakena ca …pe….
pli-tv-pvr1.8:3.1: anādariyaṃ paṭicca udake uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā kheḷaṃ vā karonto kati āpattiyo āpajjati :
pli-tv-pvr1.8:3.2: anādariyaṃ paṭicca udake uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā kheḷaṃ vā karonto ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati :
pli-tv-pvr1.8:3.4: anādariyaṃ paṭicca udake uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā kheḷaṃ vā karonto imaṃ ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati.
pli-tv-pvr1.8:4.1: sā āpatti catunnaṃ vipattīnaṃ kati vipattiyo bhajati : sattannaṃ āpattikkhandhānaṃ katīhi āpattikkhandhehi saṅgahitā : channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ katīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti : catunnaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ katamaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ : sattannaṃ, samathānaṃ katīhi samathehi sammati :
pli-tv-pvr1.8:4.2: sā āpatti catunnaṃ vipattīnaṃ ekaṃ vipattiṃ bhajati :
pli-tv-pvr1.8:4.7: kāyato ca cittato ca samuṭṭhāti, na vācato.
pli-tv-pvr1.8:4.10: siyā sammukhāvinayena ca paṭiññātakaraṇena ca, siyā sammukhāvinayena ca tiṇavatthārakena ca.
